summary: Phase 3 Polish + Accessibility frontend test (desktop 1920 + mobile 390, Playwright). WORKING: profile radars (profile-phases-radar, profile-attr-radar with 7 areas and aria-label summary), profile-metric-heatmap, profile-attr-heat (28 tiles), profile-hidden in Full view, profile-empty-pct 'Not enough minutes yet' for a 0-minute player (radar/heatmap correctly hidden), no CA/PA shown. Per-career memory (fmcc-mem:<careerId>:*): Scout filters (group FB), sort (Age), columns (All stats), More filters open, view (Fair play), compare picks (2) all survive navigating to Squad and back and a full reload; Squad last view (Depth chart) and formation (352) survive nav + reload; .content scroll (1500) restored after nav and reload. Closing a dossier flashes (row-flash) and focuses the same row in Scout Players and in the Squad Players table. Empty states: sp-empty 'Your filters rule everyone out' + Clear all filters works; min minutes 99999 shows 'Not enough minutes yet' + 'Lower the minimum to 0' (filter resets, rows return); similar-pick-empty; similar-empty with 'Any position'/'Drop the last number' (action works); loan-track-empty 'Grade a loan' focuses loan-player-select. Appearance: appearance-contrast adds html.hc + no-grain, --text #FFFFFF, --bg #000, stronger lines, persists on reload in fmcc-appearance; appearance-focus toggles strong-focus (3px outline seen); text size --z works; settings restored to defaults. Skip link appears on first Tab and Enter moves focus to #main-content. All thead th have scope; sp-table headers have aria-sort; rows tabIndex 0; Moneyball tables aria-labelled from card titles. Regression OK: finance strip (5), grouped nav (5 groups), Youth intake, lineup pitch (11 slots), Loan Manager grade A -> track -> untrack. No console errors. FAILURES: (1) Breakdown card / breakdown-heatmap never renders: Breakdown is imported in Scouting.jsx but not used anywhere (Compare tab renders Compare4 only). (2) Pressing Enter on a focused row in Scout Players, Moneyball and Similar does NOT open the dossier: sheet opens and immediately closes. (3) After 'Lower the minimum to 0' / 'Clear all filters', the Min minutes input still shows 99999 (input not controlled by state). (4) Mobile 390px: profile sheet content 483px wide inside a 389px sheet, so attribute tiles and text are cut off on the right; Scout main tab labels wrap and get clipped.

ui_bugs.issue: Breakdown card (breakdown-card / breakdown-heatmap + bar chart) is never rendered. Breakdown is imported on line 12 of Scouting.jsx but not used; the compare tab renders only <Compare4>. So the requested 'Breakdown card shows breakdown-heatmap' feature is unreachable.

Pressing Enter on a focused row opens the ProfileSheet, Radix moves focus to its Close button, and the same Enter keypress then clicks Close, so the sheet closes at once. Event log: keydown Enter on sp-row -> focusin BUTTON.Close -> click BUTTON.Close. Squad rows work because they open through a URL param. Fix: onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target === e.currentTarget) { e.preventDefault(); open(uid); } }}. The target check also stops Enter on the nested star/compare buttons from also opening the dossier.

sp-min-minutes, sp-max-value and sp-max-wage have no value prop, and sp-max-age uses defaultValue. After the empty-state 'Lower the minimum to 0' or 'Clear all filters', or after loading a saved search or a remembered filter set on reload, these inputs show stale numbers (99999 still shown while the filter is 0). Make them controlled from f.

The Body grid is 483px wide inside a 389px sheet (sheet scrollWidth 507), so the 3rd column of attribute tiles, the hidden-attribute tiles and the header text are clipped. Likely cause: grid items keep min-width:auto (the Pizza + phases row with minWidth 220 and hub-card min-width 240). Add gridTemplateColumns:'minmax(0,1fr)' or minWidth:0, and lower the hub-card min-width on small screens.

issues: Radar axis labels are clipped at the edges: 'Goalkeeping' shows as 'oalkeeping' and 'Dribbling' as 'Dribbli'. Reduce outerRadius or add margin.
Outfield players get a Goalkeeping axis (about 1.7), which pulls the radar shape in. Think about dropping that axis for non-GKs (and the outfield axes for GKs).
scout-main-tabs labels ('Find players', 'Similar players', 'Youth intake') wrap and are clipped vertically; add white-space:nowrap.
Top bar club name/date wraps and overlaps the finance strip ('2028' sits over 'FFP'); 'Raw' toggle is cut off.

loan-track-empty and similar-pick-empty use the 'Nobody qualifies yet' headline, which doesn't fit 'no loans tracked' or 'no player with that name'. Add a better reason key (e.g. 'none' -> 'Nothing here yet', 'notfound' -> 'No match for that name').
The .hc a{text-decoration:underline} rule underlines the 'Chat with your Director of Football' CTA and the footer links. Exclude button-like links.
Light theme + contrast does not override --s3, --grn, --amb or --red.

action_items: Render <Breakdown ids={compare} /> in the More tools > Compare tab (Scouting.jsx), or move it inside Compare4, so breakdown-card/breakdown-heatmap appear
Fix keyboard Enter on table rows (PlayersTab, MoneyballTab, SimilarTab, and Squad for consistency): add e.preventDefault() and only act when e.target === e.currentTarget
Make the sp-min-minutes, sp-max-value, sp-max-wage and sp-max-age inputs controlled by the filter state so they show reset or remembered values
Fix the ProfileSheet overflow at 390px (minmax(0,1fr) grid column / min-width:0) and the scout-main-tabs label wrapping
Stop the radar axis labels being clipped; think about a GK-aware attribute radar
Minor: give the sp-table an aria-label (its card has no title, so A11y does not label it) and add tabIndex/data-row-uid to the Shortlist rows (ranking-row-*) so returnToRow works there too
Minor: the Breakdown heatmap colours raw 'points' with percentile thresholds; use a scale based on the parts' max instead
critical_code_review_comments: Scouting.jsx imports Breakdown and CompareTable but never uses them (dead imports; the feature is lost)
Row onKeyDown handlers bubble from nested buttons: Enter on the sp-star/sp-compare buttons also triggers openPlayer
usePersist: changes made before the career id loads (cid null) are never saved, and the effect re-reads storage when cid arrives, overwriting them. A low-risk race on first paint
SpEmpty reads meta?.min_minutes.percentiles, which throws if meta exists without min_minutes; use optional chaining throughout
ScrollMemory restores only when el.scrollTop < want and stops after 1.2s, so slow-loading long tables may not restore. Acceptable
Similar 'Any position' loosen action can return 15 rows that are all 0% similar; consider a minimum similarity or say 'closest, but not close'
seed_data_creation: None. A tracked loan (Mateus Costa -> AC Valdora) was created and then untracked. Appearance contrast/focus/text size were restored to defaults. Formation was set back to 4231 (localStorage only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call is a fresh context (localStorage empty), and page_url is ignored, so navigate with nav-* clicks (nav-scouting, nav-squad, nav-appearance) and click 'Skip tour'. Career id 72f82391-d58c-41f7-bc47-6a46cfd10a55. TabBar ids: scout-main-tabs, scouting-tabs, scout-view-tabs, squad-view-tabs, similar-by-tabs; the selected tab has class 'on' (no aria-selected on formation tabs). To find a low-minute player, sort Mins ascending: uid 20481102 has 0 minutes. To check the Enter-on-row bug, focus tr[data-testid^=sp-row-] and press Enter, then check that [data-testid=profile-sheet] stays open.
